methods: Every boundary vertex of every subsidiary component classified by VTK ray parity, tolerance 1e-10 of model diagonal.
Every subsidiary triangle queried against all primary triangle AABBs using closed-coordinate boxes; every candidate tested with GMP exact integer/rational triangle intersection predicate.
Shared contacts count as normal only if fully contained in exact shared vertex/edge.
limitations: Primary boundary is known to still have self-intersections; containment is a geometric nesting diagnostic until primary validity is established.
No shell is deleted by this script. Noncontained or cross-boundary-intersecting components must not be removed solely by size.
Primary-to-subsidiary checks are exhaustive; primary self-pairs and subsidiary self-pairs are not part of this particular report.
